test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A train running at the speed of 95 km/h crosses a pole in 18 seconds. What is the length of the train in meters?
solution:
Given: 

Speed (S) of the train = 95 km/h 

Time (T) taken to cross the post = 18 s 

Formula used: 

S = D/T 

Concept used:

Convert the speed of the train from km/h to m/s

S = 95 × 1000/3600 = 95 × 5/18 = 475/18 m/s​

Calculation: 

According to the question, 

475/18 = D/18

⇒ D = 475/18 × 18 

⇒ D = 475 m

∴ The length of the train is 475 m.

 
• Assume the train is **stationary **and the **post is moving **at **a speed of 95 km/h **and the **length **of the **train **is the **distance travelled by the post**.
